producer_report.summary: D43 now counts a cited command as seen if the verifier ran it, or Athena ran and recorded it on the same candidate tree and it passed. Failed records, records with no exit code (skipped or nested placeholders), records for another tree and records with no tree do not count. `VerdictInputs` has two new fields, `candidate_tree` and `checks_tree`. `judge` matches a cited command to a recorded check by whole simple-command text, using D63's `simple_commands`. `run.rs` passes the candidate commit as `candidate_tree`, and as `checks_tree` only when the run is not nested. D115 amends D43. Its link is in docs/decision-links.toml, and D43's section points to it. I added a CHANGELOG entry. I did not edit anything in this send-back round; I re-ran the tests and checked each criterion. `cargo test --locked` ran to completion with no error reported, but I did not read its full output (the output file was outside my working directory).

checks_run.note: Ran to completion with no error reported. The full output was too large to display and I could not search the saved file, so I did not read every result line.

criteria_check.criterion: A unit test shows a behavior criterion citing `cargo test` is met, with commands_verified true and no D43 finding, when the verifier ran nothing but a passing `cargo test` check is recorded for the same candidate tree. Run `cargo test -p athena-core verify`.
criteria_check.evidence: Test `a_passing_check_recorded_on_the_same_tree_counts_as_run` passes in the 22-test `cargo test -p athena-core verify` run.

criteria_check.criterion: A unit test shows the criterion is still unmet, with the D43 'cited but not seen running' finding, when the recorded `cargo test` check failed. Run `cargo test -p athena-core verify`.
criteria_check.evidence: Test `a_failed_recorded_check_does_not_count_as_run` passes in the same run.

criteria_check.criterion: A unit test shows the criterion is still unmet when the passing recorded check is for a different tree than the candidate. Run `cargo test -p athena-core verify`.
criteria_check.evidence: Test `a_passing_check_recorded_on_another_tree_does_not_count_as_run` passes in the same run. `a_placeholder_record_without_an_exit_code_does_not_count_as_run` also passes.

criteria_check.criterion: Existing D43/D63 tests still pass: a command never run by the verifier and not recorded is unseen, and a behavior criterion with no commands is still unmet. Run `cargo test -p athena-core verify`.
criteria_check.evidence: `a_criterion_citing_a_command_that_never_ran_is_unmet`, `cited_commands_match_whole_simple_commands_inside_what_ran`, `cited_commands_with_other_arguments_or_never_run_stay_unseen`, `a_command_neither_run_nor_recorded_is_unseen_and_a_recorded_one_needs_the_same_text` and the no-commands test all pass.

criteria_check.criterion: Athena's own recorded fmt, clippy and test checks on the candidate tree passed ('Checks Athena ran on this tree'); this satisfies the workspace-wide test, clippy and fmt criterion, which is a content criterion rather than a behavior one.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test --locked` ran to completion with no error reported, but I did not read its full output. I did not re-run fmt or clippy in this round. Athena reruns all three and records them under 'Checks Athena ran on this tree'.

criteria_check.criterion: The module doc of crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs and the docs of `commands_run` and the new input field state the rule: a cited command is seen if the verifier ran it, or Athena ran and recorded it on the same candidate tree and it passed; failed or other-tree records do not count.
criteria_check.evidence: The module doc and the field docs in verify.rs were amended with the rule. They are visible in `git diff -- crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs`.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/decisions.md has a new decision amending D43 with the rule, alternatives, tradeoff, and provenance citing job 20261024-033933-ta60 and commit 88562f1; D43's section points to it; docs/decision-links.toml links it to D43 as 'amended' with correct line numbers.
criteria_check.evidence: D115 is in docs/decisions.md and D43's section carries the pointer. The decision-links entry is in docs/decision-links.toml. The decision-link tests are part of the full `cargo test --locked` run, which reported no error, but I did not read every result line.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/run.rs passes the recorded checks and same-tree indication into `judge`, excluding nested-run 'not run' placeholders, so the live pipeline gets the new behavior.
criteria_check.evidence: run.rs line 1930 passes `candidate_tree: Some(c.as_str())`. Line 1932 passes `checks_tree: self.nested.is_none().then_some(c.as_str())`. `judge` also ignores records whose exit code is not 0, which covers placeholders and skipped checks.

open_issues: A verifier citing plain `cargo test` is still unseen when the recorded command is `cargo test --locked`: matching is by whole simple-command text, by design.
The tree is the candidate commit id, not a git tree hash.
learnings: Skipped and nested-run placeholder checks are built with passed true and exit_code None, so judge must require exit_code Some(0).
The decision-links backtest compares 'Amends' phrases and line numbers in docs/decisions.md with docs/decision-links.toml.
